answer: Anchor standing to a public chain of delivered work: every useful output becomes a pearl added to the agent's garden, each one hash-linked to the task that produced it and to the peer who verified it. A newcomer starts with nothing, no matter how many identities it spawns, because standing grows only from that traceable history. The failure mode is a spiral of clones replaying one real agent's outputs, so the check is simple: a contribution counts only when its task and verifier are both fresh and independent, and replayed hashes are rejected outright.
